cases.title: Web Public - Organization Registration - Create an organization with the entered details
cases.description:
Verify that registration creates one organization with the chosen settings and owner access. An Organization is the business owning Events and employees, separate from the person's Showpass login. Run with a signed-in account creating its first organization and with an existing organizer creating another. Also repeat on the test site with a Showpass super-admin; Salesforce Account ID and Client Type are optional outside production.

| Platform | View |
| --- | --- |
| WebPublic | Desktop |
| WebPublic | Mobile |

Run on the legacy Angular and Next.js registration pages, using the confirmed entry link for the selected version. Current route: `/organizations/register/`. Use desktop for one page version and mobile for the other, and record the selection. This samples both views; it does not cover every page/view pairing.
cases.preconditions:
* Have the selected account: no existing organizations, owner of an existing organization, or Showpass super-admin. Record the existing organization names before starting.
* Use an approved test backend because registration creates organization ownership and can notify sales/CRM. Have a controlled phone number and an unused organization name, at most 64 characters.
* For ordinary active registration, `enable_venue_upon_registration` is ON for the account. Use CAD with known matching IP region and a name checked against the enabled similar-name rule; record the effective fraud-check switches.
* An authorized administrator can search Admin → Venues → Venue and read the new organization and its owner employment without saving.
cases.postconditions:
* Retain the created organization and its reference for the assigned cleanup owner; do not create an Event or delete existing organizations.
* Existing organization settings and access remain unchanged.

steps.expected_result: The details form is available.

steps.action: Enter the organization details.
steps.expected_result: The entered details are shown.
steps.data: Unused name; controlled phone; America/Edmonton; CAD; Google Search.

steps.action: Inspect the currency and referral choices.
steps.expected_result: Both lists contain the stated choices.
steps.data: Currencies: CAD, USD, EUR, GBP, AUD. Referral: Google Search, Platform Review Website, Showpass Marketing Email, Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, Referral, Showpass Sales Team, Trade Show, Other.

steps.action: Select Continue.
steps.expected_result: The plan page opens without creating the organization.

steps.action: Submit Professional once.
steps.expected_result: Registration completes in the new organization’s Create Event screen.
steps.data: Angular: Choose Plan under Professional. Next.js: Continue under Professional.

steps.action: Have the administrator reopen the created organization record and owner employment.
steps.expected_result: Exactly one organization has the entered details, Professional plan and the registering account as owner.

steps.action: Refresh the destination.
steps.expected_result: The new organization remains selected without another organization being created.

cases.description:
Open Customer refunds for an organization with a saved policy. Check that the fields below show its current choices. Turn the policy on, allow automatic customer refunds, and save. Then turn the policy off again. Each saved choice must still be shown after reloading.

| Platform | View |
| --- | --- |
| Dashboard | Desktop |


Expected form fields:

| Section | Field or control | Expected display |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Customer refund policy | Enable customer refund policy | On/off switch. |
| Customer refund policy | Customer outcome | Customers cannot initiate refunds; Customers can self-refund automatically. |
| Refund cutoff | Cutoff type | No cutoff; Absolute date and time; Before event start; Before item or session start; Manually closed. |
| Refund cutoff | Cutoff date and time | Date/time input with the organization timezone; shown only for Absolute date and time. |
| Refund cutoff | Time before cutoff reference | Whole-number input; shown only for Before event start or Before item or session start. |
| Refund cutoff | Unit | Hours or Days; shown only for Before event start or Before item or session start. |
| Eligibility restrictions | After barcode delivery | Block customer refunds; Allow customer refunds. |
| Eligibility restrictions | After fulfillment or shipping | Block customer refunds; Allow customer refunds. |
| Eligibility restrictions | After check-in or scan | Block customer refunds; Allow customer refunds. |
| Eligibility restrictions | Orders with mixed eligibility | Refund eligible items independently; Require the whole remaining order; Block when any remaining item is ineligible. |
| Refund amounts | Enable configurable refund amounts | On/off switch. |
| Refund amounts | Shipping refund rule | Never refund shipping; Refund after all shipped items sharing the charge are refunded; Refund shipping proportionally; Refund shipping for unshipped items only. Shown when amount rules are on. |
| Refund amounts | Refundable customer-paid fees | Multi-select: Showpass fee; Payment processing fee. Empty means neither fee class is refundable. Shown when amount rules are on. |
| Page footer | Save | Saves the policy form. |

For **No cutoff** or **Manually closed**, the date, number, and unit fields are hidden. For the other cutoff choices, only the fields needed for that choice appear.

**Time before cutoff reference** is the number of hours or days before the event or ticket/session starts. **Orders with mixed eligibility** means an order that contains both returnable and nonreturnable purchases.
cases.preconditions:
* The selected organization is included in the `enable_venue_policy_customer_self_refunds` rollout flag.
* Choose the case's English or French language in Dashboard. On a narrow screen, open the profile button → Main menu → choose the language; then widen the screen again. Check that labels, messages, and errors appear in the chosen language.
* Employee permission: **Manage Organization Info**.
* In Showpass Admin → Venue customer refund policies, search by organization name. Open its policy; if none exists, select Add → choose the organization in Venue → Save. This is a separate record from the Venue page.
* Record the current policy choices so you can restore them afterward. No order is needed.
* Before starting, open Customer refunds, turn **Enable customer refund policy** off, choose **Customers cannot initiate refunds**, and Save. Leave the other choices as they are.
cases.postconditions:
* Change Dashboard back to its original language.
* Restore the recorded policy choices, save, and reload to confirm. If you created a policy for this case, leave it saved and off.

cases.title: Dashboard - Refunds - Change when customer refunds close
cases.description:

| Platform | View |
| --- | --- |
| Dashboard | Desktop |

| CutoffScenario | Starting cutoff | New cutoff | New details |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| AbsoluteDateTime | Before event start: 48 Hours | Absolute date and time | Today + 14 days at 12:30 |
| EventHours | Absolute date and time | Before event start | 48 Hours |
| EventDays | Absolute date and time | Before event start | 2 Days |
| ItemHours | Absolute date and time | Before item or session start | 24 Hours |
| ItemDays | Absolute date and time | Before item or session start | 1 Day |
| NoCutoff | Before item or session start: 2 Days | No cutoff | No additional fields |
| ManuallyClosed | Absolute date and time | Manually closed | No additional fields |

cases.description:
With the organization policy off, turn on **Allow customer-initiated refunds** for a ticket type or product and save it. Check that the choice survives a name change and stays on when the organization policy is turned on and then off again. The message beside the item switch must reflect whether the organization policy is on or off.

| Dashboard | Desktop |

| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| TicketType | Dashboard → Build → Events → All events → Edit the prepared event → Tickets → Edit Refund Ticket → Basic info | Refund Ticket | Name on Basic info | Ticket type basic info updated successfully |
| Product | Dashboard → Build → Products → All products → Refund Policy Product → Fulfillment | Refund Policy Product | Product Name on Basic info | Product saved. |

cases.title: Dashboard - Refunds - Save shipping and fee choices
cases.description:
An employee saves a shipping rule and a fee selection, then reopens Customer refunds to confirm both choices. Turning configurable amounts off hides the controls without deleting those saved choices. | ShippingRule | Select under Shipping refund rule |
| --- | --- |
| Never | Never refund shipping |
| AfterAll | Refund after all shipped items sharing the charge are refunded |
| Proportional | Refund shipping proportionally |
| UnshippedOnly | Refund shipping for unshipped items only |

| FeeSelection | Select under Refundable customer-paid fees |
| --- | --- |
| None | Clear both choices. |
| ShowpassOnly | Showpass fee only. |
| ProcessingOnly | Payment processing fee only. |
| Both | Showpass fee and Payment processing fee. |

For example, ShippingRule = Never with FeeSelection = ProcessingOnly means save **Never refund shipping** with only **Payment processing fee** selected.

cases.title: My Orders - Refunds - Let a customer select a purchased ticket or product after refunds are enabled for it
cases.description:
A customer buys the items listed for ItemType while the selected item's **Allow customer-initiated refunds** switch is off. An employee turns that switch on, and the customer reopens the same order to check that the correct purchase becomes selectable. This case reads the return preview and cancels; it does not complete a refund. A ticket package is one purchase containing included tickets; the package listing is selected for return, not an included ticket on its own.

| ItemType | Configure before purchase | Buy and identify | Switch changed during this case | Expected return selection after saving |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| TicketType | A public General Admission ticket, price 10.00, inventory 10; no package, assigned seat, discount, or payment plan. Refund switch off. | Buy quantity 1 and record event and ticket type. | Purchased ticket type → Basic info. | Exactly that ticket; quantity 1. |
| Product | A General Admission ticket, price 10.00, plus one product variant, price 15.00, inventory 10. Both refund switches off. Offer the product as a checkout add-on for this event. | Buy quantity 1 of the ticket and quantity 1 of the product in the same checkout; record product and variant names. | Purchased product → Fulfillment. | Exactly the product variant; the accompanying ticket stays blocked. |
| StandaloneProduct | One product variant, price 15.00, inventory 10; refund switch off; Visible on Your Venue Page on. | On the organization's public page, buy quantity 1 of that product without a ticket. | Purchased product → Fulfillment. | Exactly the product variant; there is no admission ticket in the order. |
| AssignedSeat | A public, paid ticket for one individually selectable seat in a future event with an existing seating map. Refund switch off; no package, full-table requirement, membership, shared hold, or resale. | Buy one available seat and record event, ticket type, section, row, seat, and paid price. | Purchased ticket type → Basic info. | The one ticket for the recorded seat; it remains owned by the customer because the return is cancelled. |
| TicketPackage | A Preset package priced 20.00 containing quantity 1 of each of two different General Admission ticket types. Included ticket switches on; package listing ticket switch off. Send a single barcode on; Allow redemption on any included item off. | Buy quantity 1 of the package and record its listing plus both included ticket types. | Package listing ticket type → Basic info. | The package listing is selectable as one purchase; included tickets cannot be returned independently. |
cases.preconditions:
- The preparing employee has **Manage Organization Info** and **Manage Events**; Product and StandaloneProduct also require **Manage Marketplace** and an organization not on Basic pricing.
